introduction: The Housing Authority of the County of Kern administers several affordable housing programs. Apply to the specific program or property whose waiting list is accepting applications.

who: Eligibility depends on the housing program, household income and other requirements. Some properties have additional senior or farmworker criteria.
sections.get: Options include public housing, Housing Choice Vouchers and project-based assistance. Project-based vouchers support specific apartments; assistance is not automatically portable when a tenant moves.
sections.docs: Prepare household names, birth dates, Social Security numbers where required, and reliable phone and email contact details. Ask about reasonable accommodation or translation help if needed to apply.
sections.apply: Start with the Housing Authority’s housing listings. The project-based voucher page currently lists online intake through kernhousing.com. Apply separately to each relevant open location.
sections.after: Save confirmation messages and monitor email. Report household or address changes through the applicant account. A waiting-list application is not an immediate housing offer; ask about the correct list if your needs change.

faqs: Are all housing lists open together?
No. Check the particular program or property.
Does a project-based voucher move with me?
Assistance is tied to the apartment and may not be transferable when you leave.
The reviewed page lists an opening from May 1, 2026; check for changes before applying.
Can I request help using the online process?
Call 661-631-8500 about reasonable accommodation or translation services.

provenance.review_scope: Program purpose, eligibility pathway and application methods; no unverified dollar limits published.
